partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Adverse-filtered phenotype-anatomy mechanism
results.hypothesis: The tissue mechanism is stronger when a disease phenotype localizes to the same anatomy in which Bgee expresses the inhibited causal gene.
results.body: R037 plus disease -has_phenotype-> phenotype -located_in|occurs_in-> same target-expression anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: Forms a nonlinear target-expression, disease-location, phenotype-location, and adverse-phenotype graph, but the localization branches are literature-derived and disease direction remains absent.
results.trapi_notes: The nonlinear positive and adverse motifs are TRAPI-expressible; exact absence, provenance, anatomy specificity, NPMI, and degree constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]-(object)
MATCH (object)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
      -[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'NCBITaxon:9606' IN coalesce(gene.in_taxon, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 200
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4
      )
    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R037 with same shared anatomy disease degree <=50 and human Bgee gene-expression degree <=6000
results.mechanism_rationale: Constrains both disease and expression fanout of the anatomical bridge, but disease activity direction remains unresolved.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse motifs are TRAPI-expressible; two anatomy degrees, exact absence, provenance, NPMI, and target degree require post-processing or Cypher.
